changes: April emits status only because March's bill is unobserved; NO_BALANCE separates non-positive reference bills from COVERED payments against a positive bill.

payment.PARTIAL: reference bill > 0 and 0 < PAY_AMT_k < reference bill
payment.NO_BALANCE: reference bill <= 0 (nothing was due, whatever the payment)

itemMapping.paymentRulePrecedence: April: status only; for months 5..1 use BILL_AMT_(k+1). If reference bill <= 0: NO_BALANCE; else if PAY_AMT_k = 0: NONE; else if PAY_AMT_k < reference bill: PARTIAL; else: COVERED
itemMapping.oldestMonthReference: April (PAY_6) has no payment item because March's bill is unobserved

patternSelection.method: holdout patterns selected on training rows; CV patterns reselected inside each training fold
